249	class _Lexer:
250	    """带模式的字符流词法分析器（按需逐个产出 token）。
251	
252	    - 普通模式逐字节复刻历史词法：{}."?* 为独立 token，FILTER 圆括号区间内
253	      ()!= 为独立 token，其余字符（包括 ^ / | + 以及区间外的括号、叹号、等号）
254	      都可以是名称的一部分；
255	    - 路径模式只在三元组谓语槽开启：^ / | + 与圆括号成为路径运算符，
256	      单独出现的 '?'（后不随变量字符）成为量词 QUESTION。'*' 在两种模式下
257	      都是 STAR（投影星号或路径量词由解析器区分）。
258	    模式在读完主语后、解析谓语前切换，宾语与后续 token 仍按普通模式切分，
259	    因此主语/宾语位置的旧词法（如名为 'a/b' 的常量）完全不变。
260	    """
261	
262	    def __init__(self, text: str) -> None:
263	        self.text = text
264	        self.n = len(text)
265	        self.pos = 0
266	        self.mode = _MODE_NORMAL
267	        self.filter_spans = _find_filter_spans(text)
268	        self.span_starts = {start for start, _ in self.filter_spans}
269	        self.span_i = 0
270	
271	    def rewind(self, pos: int) -> None:
272	        # 重置字符位置与 FILTER 区间游标：区间判定只随位置单调前进，
273	        # 回退后需要从头重新对齐。
274	        self.pos = pos
275	        self.span_i = 0
276	
277	    def set_mode(self, mode: str) -> None:
278	        self.mode = mode
279	
280	    def _in_filter(self, pos: int) -> bool:
281	        while self.span_i < len(self.filter_spans) and pos > self.filter_spans[self.span_i][1]:
282	            self.span_i += 1
283	        return (
284	            self.span_i < len(self.filter_spans)
285	            and self.filter_spans[self.span_i][0] <= pos <= self.filter_spans[self.span_i][1]
286	        )
287	
288	    def next(self):
289	        """返回下一个 token；输入结束时返回 None。"""
290	        text = self.text
291	        n = self.n
292	        i = self.pos
293	        while i < n and text[i].isspace():
294	            i += 1
295	        if i >= n:
296	            self.pos = i
297	            return None
298	        ch = text[i]
299	        if self.mode == _MODE_PATH:
300	            return self._next_path(i, ch, text, n)
301	        return self._next_normal(i, ch, text, n)
302	
303	    def _next_normal(self, i: int, ch: str, text: str, n: int) -> _Token:
304	        if ch == "{":
305	            self.pos = i + 1
306	            return _Token(_TOK_LBRACE, ch, i)
307	        if ch == "}":
308	            self.pos = i + 1
309	            return _Token(_TOK_RBRACE, ch, i)
310	        if ch == ".":
311	            self.pos = i + 1
312	            return _Token(_TOK_DOT, ch, i)
313	        if ch == "*":
314	            self.pos = i + 1
315	            return _Token(_TOK_STAR, ch, i)
316	        if self._in_filter(i):
317	            if ch == "(":
318	                self.pos = i + 1
319	                return _Token(_TOK_LPAREN, ch, i)
320	            if ch == ")":
321	                self.pos = i + 1
322	                return _Token(_TOK_RPAREN, ch, i)
323	            if ch == "!":
324	                if i + 1 < n and text[i + 1] == "=":
325	                    self.pos = i + 2
326	                    return _Token(_TOK_NE, "!=", i)
327	                self.pos = i + 1
328	                return _Token(_TOK_BANG, "!", i)
329	            if ch == "=":
330	                self.pos = i + 1
331	                return _Token(_TOK_EQ, "=", i)
332	        if ch == "?":
333	            start = i
334	            j = i + 1
335	            while j < n and _is_var_char(text[j]):
336	                j += 1
337	            if j == i + 1:
338	                raise OntologyError(
339	                    f"词法错误：'?' 后必须至少跟随一个字母、数字或下划线"
340	                    f"（字符位置 {start}）"
341	                )
342	            self.pos = j
343	            return _Token(_TOK_VAR, text[start:j], start)
344	        if ch == '"':
345	            return self._next_string(i, text, n)
346	        # 普通名称：FILTER 区间内额外以 ()!= 为界，区间外它们仍是名称字符
347	        delimiters = _DELIMITERS | _FILTER_DELIMITERS if self._in_filter(i) else _DELIMITERS
348	        start = i
349	        j = i
350	        while j < n and not text[j].isspace() and text[j] not in delimiters:
351	            # 'FILTER(' 无空格时，左括号是独立区间起点，名称只取到 FILTER
352	            if j > start and j in self.span_starts:
353	                break
354	            j += 1
355	        self.pos = j
356	        return _Token(_TOK_NAME, text[start:j], start)
357	
358	    def _next_path(self, i: int, ch: str, text: str, n: int) -> _Token:
359	        simple = {
360	            "{": _TOK_LBRACE,
361	            "}": _TOK_RBRACE,
362	            ".": _TOK_DOT,
363	            "*": _TOK_STAR,
364	            "(": _TOK_LPAREN,
365	            ")": _TOK_RPAREN,
366	            "^": _TOK_HAT,
367	            "/": _TOK_SLASH,
368	            "|": _TOK_PIPE,
369	            "+": _TOK_PLUS,
370	        }
371	        if ch in simple:
372	            self.pos = i + 1
373	            return _Token(simple[ch], ch, i)
374	        if ch == "?":
375	            # 后随变量字符时仍是变量（如宾语 ?y），否则才是路径量词
376	            if i + 1 < n and _is_var_char(text[i + 1]):
377	                j = i + 1
378	                while j < n and _is_var_char(text[j]):
379	                    j += 1
380	                self.pos = j
381	                return _Token(_TOK_VAR, text[i:j], i)
382	            self.pos = i + 1
383	            return _Token(_TOK_QUESTION, "?", i)
384	        if ch == '"':
385	            return self._next_string(i, text, n)
386	        start = i
387	        j = i
388	        while (
389	            j < n
390	            and not text[j].isspace()
391	            and text[j] not in _PATH_NAME_DELIMITERS
392	        ):
393	            j += 1
394	        self.pos = j
395	        return _Token(_TOK_NAME, text[start:j], start)
396	
397	    def _next_string(self, i: int, text: str, n: int) -> _Token:
398	        start = i
399	        j = i + 1
400	        while j < n:
401	            if text[j] == "\\":
402	                j += 2
403	                continue
404	            if text[j] == '"':
405	                break
406	            j += 1
407	        if j >= n:
408	            raise OntologyError(f"词法错误：字符串未闭合（字符位置 {start}）")
409	        raw = text[start : j + 1]
410	        try:
411	            value = json.loads(raw)
412	        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
413	            raise OntologyError(
414	                f"词法错误：非法的 JSON 字符串（字符位置 {start}）：{exc.msg}"
415	            ) from exc
416	        if not isinstance(value, str):  # pragma: no cover - 双引号内容必为 JSON 字符串
417	            raise OntologyError(
418	                f"词法错误：字符串常量必须解码为字符串（字符位置 {start}）"
419	            )
420	        self.pos = j + 1
421	        return _Token(_TOK_STRING, value, start)

451	class _Parser:
452	    """把 token 流编译为 (投影变量名列表, 模式子句列表, 是否星号投影)。
453	
454	    模式子句为三元组：
455	    - (_CLAUSE_BGP, patterns, None)
456	    - (_CLAUSE_OPTIONAL, patterns, None)
457	    - (_CLAUSE_FILTER, None, 表达式元组)
458	    - (_CLAUSE_UNION, branches, None)：branches 为分支模式列表的列表
459	    每个三元组模式为 (主语项, 谓语, 宾语项)，主语/宾语为 (种类, 值, 位置)，
460	    谓语为 _Path（普通属性名是只含一个 edge 节点的路径）。
461	    模式序号在整个 WHERE 体内连续编号，BGP、OPTIONAL 与 UNION 分支中的
462	    三元组一并计数；FILTER 不占用三元组序号。
463	    """
464	
465	    def __init__(self, text: str, lexer: "_Lexer", properties: frozenset) -> None:
466	        self._text = text
467	        self._lexer = lexer
468	        self._queue = deque()
469	        self._properties = frozenset(properties)
470	        # 三元组模式序号在整个 WHERE 体内连续编号（含 OPTIONAL 块内模式）
471	        self._pattern_index = 0
472	        # 上一个已消费 token；谓语槽开始的原始字符位置
473	        self._last = None
474	        self._pred_start = len(text)
475	
476	    def _fill(self, count: int = 0) -> None:
477	        """保证预读队列至少含 count+1 个 token（EOF 后队列不再增长）。"""
478	        while len(self._queue) <= count:
479	            tok = self._lexer.next()
480	            if tok is None:
481	                break
482	            self._queue.append(tok)
483	
484	    def _peek(self) -> _Token:
485	        self._fill(0)
486	        return self._queue[0]
487	
488	    def _peek2(self):
489	        self._fill(1)
490	        return self._queue[1] if len(self._queue) > 1 else None
491	
492	    def _eof(self) -> bool:
493	        self._fill(0)
494	        return not self._queue
495	
496	    def _advance(self) -> None:
497	        self._fill(0)
498	        self._last = self._queue.popleft()
499	
500	    def _error(self, message: str, pos: int) -> "OntologyError":
501	        return OntologyError(f"{message}（字符位置 {pos}）")
502	
503	    def _here_pos(self) -> int:
504	        return self._peek().pos if not self._eof() else len(self._text)
505	
506	    def _next_is(self, kind: str) -> bool:
507	        tok = self._peek2()
508	        return tok is not None and tok.kind == kind

510	    def _enter_path_mode(self) -> None:
511	        """谓语槽开始：切到路径词法模式并重切尚未按该模式读取的字符。"""
512	        self._lexer.rewind(self._pred_start)
513	        self._lexer.set_mode(_MODE_PATH)
514	        self._queue.clear()

516	    def _try_constant_predicate(self, start: int):
517	        """按旧词法读取谓语槽的一整个名称：若恰为已声明属性则作为常量边。
518	
519	        这样名称中含路径字符（如已声明属性 'a/b'、'x(y)'）的旧查询不会被
520	        新路径规则拆散；普通属性名也走这条常量边，结果与单节点路径一致。
521	        返回 None 表示该名称不是已声明属性，应改按属性路径解析。
522	        """
523	        text = self._text
524	        n = len(text)
525	        j = start
526	        while j < n and not text[j].isspace() and text[j] not in '{}."?*':
527	            j += 1
528	        name = text[start:j]
529	        k = j
530	        while k < n and text[k].isspace():
531	            k += 1
532	        following = text[k] if k < n else ""
533	        glued_qvar = (
534	            following == "?" and k + 1 < n and _is_var_char(text[k + 1])
535	        )
536	        # 名称后（允许隔着空白）紧跟路径运算符时按路径解析：
537	        # knows*、knows+、knows/b、a|b 以及空格形式 knows * 等。
538	        # 裸 '?'（后不随变量字符，如 knows?）是路径量词；紧接 '?变量'
539	        # （knows?y）则是旧词法“谓语 knows + 宾语变量 ?y”的合法写法。
540	        bare_question = following == "?" and not glued_qvar
541	        path_continuation = following in "*/|+" or bare_question
542	        declared = bool(name) and name in self._properties
543	        if declared and not path_continuation and (
544	            glued_qvar or following in (".", '"', "}", "?") or following == ""
545	        ):
546	            self._lexer.rewind(j)  # 留在普通模式，宾语按旧词法切分
547	            self._queue.clear()
548	            return _Path(("edge", name), start)
549	        return None

551	    def _leave_path_mode(self) -> None:
552	        """谓语槽结束：终止符（宾语/点/右花括号）按普通模式重新切分。"""
553	        self._lexer.set_mode(_MODE_NORMAL)
554	        if self._queue:
555	            self._lexer.rewind(self._queue[0].pos)
556	            self._queue.clear()

558	    def _expect_keyword(self, word: str) -> _Token:
559	        if self._eof():
560	            pos = len(self._text)
561	            raise self._error(f"查询缺少关键字 {word}，或存在未知语句成分", pos)
562	        tok = self._peek()
563	        if tok.kind != _TOK_NAME or tok.value != word:
564	            raise self._error(
565	                f"查询缺少关键字 {word}，或存在未知语句成分 {tok.value!r}",
566	                tok.pos,
567	            )
568	        self._advance()
569	        return tok

571	    def parse(self) -> Tuple[Tuple[str, ...], List[tuple], bool]:
572	        self._expect_keyword("SELECT")
573	        projection, star = self._parse_projection()
574	        self._expect_keyword("WHERE")
575	        if self._eof() or self._peek().kind != _TOK_LBRACE:
576	            raise self._error("WHERE 后缺少左花括号 '{'", self._here_pos())
577	        self._advance()
578	        clauses = self._parse_group_body(optional=False)
579	        # _parse_group_body 已消费右花括号
580	        if not self._eof():
581	            tok = self._peek()
582	            raise self._error(f"右花括号后存在未知语句成分 {tok.value!r}", tok.pos)
583	        self._validate_projection(projection, clauses)
584	        return tuple(name for name, _ in projection), clauses, star

586	    def _parse_projection(self) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[str, int]], bool]:
587	        if self._eof():
588	            raise self._error("SELECT 后缺少投影变量或 '*'", len(self._text))
589	        if self._peek().kind == _TOK_STAR:
590	            self._advance()
591	            # '*' 后必须紧跟 WHERE
592	            if self._eof() or self._peek().kind != _TOK_NAME or self._peek().value != "WHERE":
593	                raise self._error("'*' 与 WHERE 之间存在未知语句成分", self._here_pos())
594	            return [], True
595	
596	        names: List[Tuple[str, int]] = []
597	        seen = set()
598	        while not self._eof():
599	            tok = self._peek()
600	            if tok.kind == _TOK_NAME and tok.value == "WHERE":
601	                break
602	            if tok.kind != _TOK_VAR:
603	                raise self._error(
604	                    f"SELECT 后只能出现变量或 '*'，遇到未知语句成分 {tok.value!r}",
605	                    tok.pos,
606	                )
607	            if tok.value in seen:
608	                raise self._error(
609	                    f"投影变量 {tok.value} 重复（字符位置 {tok.pos}）",
610	                    tok.pos,
611	                )
612	            seen.add(tok.value)
613	            names.append((tok.value, tok.pos))
614	            self._advance()
615	        if not names:
616	            raise self._error("SELECT 后缺少投影变量或 '*'", self._here_pos())
617	        return names, False

619	    def _parse_group_body(self, optional: bool) -> List[tuple]:
620	        """解析 '{' 之后直到匹配 '}' 的模式组，返回子句列表（已消费 '}'）。"""
621	        scope = "OPTIONAL 块" if optional else "WHERE 模式体"
622	        clauses: List[tuple] = []
623	        pending: List[Tuple[Any, Any, Any]] = []
624	        # prev_dot：上一个 token 是否为点号（拒绝连续点号）；
625	        # clause_ok：当前位置是否允许出现 OPTIONAL/FILTER 子句
626	        # （组首、点号之后或前一子句之后）。
627	        prev_dot = False
628	        clause_ok = True
629	        lbrace_pos = self._last.pos
630	
631	        def finish_pattern() -> None:
632	            if len(pending) != 3:
633	                pos = _pending_item_pos(pending[-1]) if pending else lbrace_pos
634	                raise OntologyError(
635	                    f"三元组模式 {self._pattern_index} 项数不足："
636	                    f"需要主语、谓语、宾语三项（字符位置 {pos}）"
637	                )
638	            s, p, o = pending
639	            if not isinstance(p, _Path):
640	                raise OntologyError(
641	                    f"三元组模式 {self._pattern_index} 的谓语不能是变量 {p[1]}"
642	                    f"（字符位置 {p[2]}）"
643	                )
644	            clauses.append((_CLAUSE_BGP, [(s, p, o)], None))
645	            pending.clear()
646	            self._pattern_index += 1
647	
648	        while True:
649	            if self._eof():
650	                raise self._error(f"{scope}缺少右花括号 '}}'", len(self._text))
651	            tok = self._peek()
652	
653	            if tok.kind == _TOK_RBRACE:
654	                if pending:
655	                    finish_pattern()
656	                self._advance()
657	                break
658	
659	            if tok.kind == _TOK_DOT:
660	                if pending:
661	                    finish_pattern()
662	                elif prev_dot or not clauses:
663	                    raise self._error(
664	                        "点号 '.' 只能出现在一条完整三元组模式或子句之后",
665	                        tok.pos,
666	                    )
667	                prev_dot = True
668	                clause_ok = True
669	                self._advance()
670	                continue
671	
672	            # 子句关键字只在模式边界成立；未跟起始符号的关键字按普通常量处理。
673	            if clause_ok and tok.kind == _TOK_NAME and tok.value == "OPTIONAL" and self._next_is(_TOK_LBRACE):
674	                if optional:
675	                    raise self._error(
676	                        "OPTIONAL 块内不得再嵌套 OPTIONAL 块",
677	                        tok.pos,
678	                    )
679	                clauses.append(self._parse_optional_clause())
680	                prev_dot = False
681	                clause_ok = True
682	                continue
683	
684	            if clause_ok and tok.kind == _TOK_NAME and tok.value == "FILTER" and self._next_is(_TOK_LPAREN):
685	                if optional:
686	                    raise self._error(
687	                        "OPTIONAL 块内只允许出现三元组模式，不得使用 FILTER",
688	                        tok.pos,
689	                    )
690	                clauses.append(self._parse_filter_clause())
691	                prev_dot = False
692	                clause_ok = True
693	                continue
694	
695	            # UNION 选择分支：'{' 分支 '}' (UNION '{' 分支 '}')+，只在 WHERE 主体出现
696	            if clause_ok and tok.kind == _TOK_LBRACE:
697	                if optional:
698	                    raise self._error(
699	                        "OPTIONAL 块内只允许出现三元组模式，不得嵌套花括号组",
700	                        tok.pos,
701	                    )
702	                clauses.append(self._parse_union_clause())
703	                prev_dot = False
704	                clause_ok = True
705	                continue
706	
707	            # UNION 关键字两侧必须是相邻的独立花括号组
708	            if clause_ok and tok.kind == _TOK_NAME and tok.value == "UNION":
709	                raise self._error(
710	                    "UNION 两侧必须是相邻的独立花括号组",
711	                    tok.pos,
712	                )
713	
714	            if len(pending) == 3:
715	                raise self._error(
716	                    f"三元组模式 {self._pattern_index} 项数过多："
717	                    f"模式之间需要用 '.' 分隔",
718	                    tok.pos,
719	                )
720	            if len(pending) == 1:
721	                if tok.kind == _TOK_VAR:
722	                    # 谓语位置的变量先作为槽位收集，交由 finish_pattern
723	                    # 按“先项数、后变量谓语”的既有顺序报错
724	                    pending.append((_VAR, tok.value, tok.pos))
725	                    self._advance()
726	                else:
727	                    # 谓语位置：优先按旧词法识别“恰好是已声明属性”的常量名
728	                    # （名称中允许含路径字符）；否则按属性路径解析。
729	                    self._pred_start = tok.pos
730	                    path = self._try_constant_predicate(tok.pos)
731	                    if path is None:
732	                        # 仅在该槽按路径模式重切词法，结束后宾语恢复普通词法。
733	                        self._enter_path_mode()
734	                        path = self._parse_path()
735	                        self._leave_path_mode()
736	                    pending.append(path)
737	            elif tok.kind == _TOK_VAR:
738	                pending.append((_VAR, tok.value, tok.pos))
739	                self._advance()
740	            elif tok.kind in (_TOK_NAME, _TOK_STRING):
741	                pending.append((_LIT, tok.value, tok.pos))
742	                self._advance()
743	            else:
744	                raise self._error(
745	                    f"三元组模式 {self._pattern_index} 中存在未知语句成分"
746	                    f" {tok.value!r}",
747	                    tok.pos,
748	                )
749	            prev_dot = False
750	            clause_ok = False
751	
752	        if not any(kind != _CLAUSE_FILTER for kind, _, _ in clauses):
753	            raise OntologyError(
754	                f"{'OPTIONAL' if optional else 'WHERE'} 花括号内的模式组为空"
755	                f"（字符位置 {lbrace_pos}）"
756	            )
757	        return clauses

759	    def _parse_optional_clause(self) -> tuple:
760	        """解析 OPTIONAL { ... }，关键字为当前 token。"""
761	        kw = self._peek()
762	        self._advance()
763	        if self._eof() or self._peek().kind != _TOK_LBRACE:
764	            raise self._error(
765	                "OPTIONAL 后缺少左花括号 '{'",
766	                self._here_pos(),
767	            )
768	        self._advance()
769	        inner = self._parse_group_body(optional=True)
770	        patterns: List[Tuple[Any, Any, Any]] = []
771	        for kind, group, _ in inner:
772	            if kind != _CLAUSE_BGP:  # pragma: no cover - 解析器已拒绝嵌套分组
773	                raise self._error(
774	                    "OPTIONAL 块内只允许出现三元组模式，不得嵌套",
775	                    kw.pos,
776	                )
777	            patterns.extend(group)
778	        return (_CLAUSE_OPTIONAL, patterns, None)

780	    def _parse_union_clause(self) -> tuple:
781	        """解析 '{' 分支 '}' (UNION '{' 分支 '}')+，首个 '{' 为当前 token。
782	
783	        连续 UNION 从左到右结合；并集满足结合律，因此扁平化为一个子句，
784	        分支按出现顺序编号（从 1 开始）用于错误定位。
785	        """
786	        branches: List[List[Tuple[Any, Any, Any]]] = []
787	        while True:
788	            index = len(branches) + 1
789	            self._advance()  # 消费分支的 '{'
790	            branches.append(self._parse_union_branch(index))
791	            if (
792	                not self._eof()
793	                and self._peek().kind == _TOK_NAME
794	                and self._peek().value == "UNION"
795	            ):
796	                self._advance()
797	                if self._eof() or self._peek().kind != _TOK_LBRACE:
798	                    raise self._error(
799	                        f"UNION 后缺少左花括号 '{{'（分支 {index + 1}）",
800	                        self._here_pos(),
801	                    )
802	                continue
803	            break
804	        if len(branches) < 2:
805	            raise self._error(
806	                "相邻花括号组之间缺少 UNION 关键字（分支 1）",
807	                self._here_pos(),
808	            )
809	        return (_CLAUSE_UNION, branches, None)

811	    def _parse_union_branch(self, index: int) -> List[Tuple[Any, Any, Any]]:
812	        """解析 UNION 单个分支 '{' 之后直到匹配 '}' 的三元组模式（已消费 '}'）。
813	
814	        分支内只允许一个或多个三元组模式，不得嵌套 UNION、OPTIONAL 或
815	        FILTER，也不得为空；模式之间与分支末尾沿用可选点号规则。
816	        """
817	        patterns: List[Tuple[Any, Any, Any]] = []
818	        pending: List[Tuple[Any, Any, Any]] = []
819	        prev_dot = False
820	        lbrace_pos = self._last.pos
821	
822	        def finish_pattern() -> None:
823	            if len(pending) != 3:
824	                pos = _pending_item_pos(pending[-1]) if pending else lbrace_pos
825	                raise OntologyError(
826	                    f"三元组模式 {self._pattern_index} 项数不足："
827	                    f"需要主语、谓语、宾语三项（字符位置 {pos}）"
828	                )
829	            s, p, o = pending
830	            if not isinstance(p, _Path):
831	                raise OntologyError(
832	                    f"三元组模式 {self._pattern_index} 的谓语不能是变量 {p[1]}"
833	                    f"（字符位置 {p[2]}）"
834	                )
835	            patterns.append((s, p, o))
836	            pending.clear()
837	            self._pattern_index += 1
838	
839	        while True:
840	            if self._eof():
841	                raise self._error(
842	                    f"UNION 分支 {index} 缺少右花括号 '}}'",
843	                    len(self._text),
844	                )
845	            tok = self._peek()
846	
847	            if tok.kind == _TOK_RBRACE:
848	                if pending:
849	                    finish_pattern()
850	                self._advance()
851	                break
852	
853	            if tok.kind == _TOK_DOT:
854	                if pending:
855	                    finish_pattern()
856	                elif prev_dot or not patterns:
857	                    raise self._error(
858	                        "点号 '.' 只能出现在一条完整三元组模式或子句之后",
859	                        tok.pos,
860	                    )
861	                prev_dot = True
862	                self._advance()
863	                continue
864	
865	            # 分支边界（组首或点号之后）上的保留字与嵌套组一律拒绝
866	            if not pending:
867	                if tok.kind == _TOK_LBRACE:
868	                    raise self._error(
869	                        f"UNION 分支 {index} 内不得嵌套花括号组",
870	                        tok.pos,
871	                    )
872	                if tok.kind == _TOK_NAME and tok.value == "UNION":
873	                    raise self._error(
874	                        f"UNION 分支 {index} 内不得嵌套 UNION",
875	                        tok.pos,
876	                    )
877	                if (
878	                    tok.kind == _TOK_NAME
879	                    and tok.value == "OPTIONAL"
880	                    and self._next_is(_TOK_LBRACE)
881	                ):
882	                    raise self._error(
883	                        f"UNION 分支 {index} 内只允许出现三元组模式，不得使用 OPTIONAL",
884	                        tok.pos,
885	                    )
886	                if (
887	                    tok.kind == _TOK_NAME
888	                    and tok.value == "FILTER"
889	                    and self._next_is(_TOK_LPAREN)
890	                ):
891	                    raise self._error(
892	                        f"UNION 分支 {index} 内只允许出现三元组模式，不得使用 FILTER",
893	                        tok.pos,
894	                    )
895	
896	            if len(pending) == 3:
897	                raise self._error(
898	                    f"三元组模式 {self._pattern_index} 项数过多："
899	                    f"模式之间需要用 '.' 分隔",
900	                    tok.pos,
901	                )
902	            if len(pending) == 1:
903	                if tok.kind == _TOK_VAR:
904	                    # 谓语位置的变量先作为槽位收集，交由 finish_pattern
905	                    # 按“先项数、后变量谓语”的既有顺序报错
906	                    pending.append((_VAR, tok.value, tok.pos))
907	                    self._advance()
908	                else:
909	                    # 谓语位置：优先按旧词法识别“恰好是已声明属性”的常量名
910	                    # （名称中允许含路径字符）；否则按属性路径解析。
911	                    self._pred_start = tok.pos
912	                    path = self._try_constant_predicate(tok.pos)
913	                    if path is None:
914	                        # 仅在该槽按路径模式重切词法，结束后宾语恢复普通词法。
915	                        self._enter_path_mode()
916	                        path = self._parse_path()
917	                        self._leave_path_mode()
918	                    pending.append(path)
919	            elif tok.kind == _TOK_VAR:
920	                pending.append((_VAR, tok.value, tok.pos))
921	                self._advance()
922	            elif tok.kind in (_TOK_NAME, _TOK_STRING):
923	                pending.append((_LIT, tok.value, tok.pos))
924	                self._advance()
925	            else:
926	                raise self._error(
927	                    f"三元组模式 {self._pattern_index} 中存在未知语句成分"
928	                    f" {tok.value!r}",
929	                    tok.pos,
930	                )
931	            prev_dot = False
932	
933	        if not patterns:
934	            raise OntologyError(
935	                f"UNION 分支 {index} 为空：分支内没有三元组模式"
936	                f"（字符位置 {lbrace_pos}）"
937	            )
938	        return patterns

940	    # ---------- 属性路径解析（谓语位置） ----------
941	    #
942	    # 文法（'|' 优先级最低，'/' 次之，量词 ? * + 绑定到前一主项，'^' 为前缀）：
943	    #   alternative := sequence ('|' sequence)*
944	    #   sequence    := postfix ('/' postfix)*
945	    #   postfix     := primary ('?' | '*' | '+')?
946	    #   primary     := NAME | STRING | '(' alternative ')' | '^' primary
947	    # 路径只在三元组的谓语槽被调用，因此 '.'、'}' 天然作为路径结束符。
948	
949	    def _parse_path(self) -> _Path:
950	        start = self._here_pos()
951	        tree = self._parse_path_alternative()
952	        return _Path(tree, start)
953	
954	    def _parse_path_alternative(self) -> tuple:
955	        tree = self._parse_path_sequence()
956	        while not self._eof() and self._peek().kind == _TOK_PIPE:
957	            op = self._peek()
958	            self._advance()
959	            if self._path_at_end():
960	                raise self._error(
961	                    f"属性路径的选择运算符 '|' 后缺少路径（三元组模式 "
962	                    f"{self._pattern_index} 的谓语）",
963	                    op.pos,
964	                )
965	            right = self._parse_path_sequence()
966	            tree = ("alt", tree, right)
967	        return tree
968	
969	    def _parse_path_sequence(self) -> tuple:
970	        tree = self._parse_path_postfix()
971	        while not self._eof() and self._peek().kind == _TOK_SLASH:
972	            op = self._peek()
973	            self._advance()
974	            if self._path_at_end():
975	                raise self._error(
976	                    f"属性路径的序列运算符 '/' 后缺少路径（三元组模式 "
977	                    f"{self._pattern_index} 的谓语）",
978	                    op.pos,
979	                )
980	            right = self._parse_path_postfix()
981	            tree = ("seq", tree, right)
982	        return tree
983	
984	    def _parse_path_postfix(self) -> tuple:
985	        tree = self._parse_path_primary()
986	        if self._eof() or self._peek().kind not in (
987	            _TOK_QUESTION,
988	            _TOK_STAR,
989	            _TOK_PLUS,
990	        ):
991	            return tree
992	        quant = self._peek()
993	        self._advance()
994	        kind = {
995	            _TOK_QUESTION: "zeroone",
996	            _TOK_STAR: "zero",
997	            _TOK_PLUS: "oneplus",

1268	class _PathMatcher:
1269	    """把属性路径 AST 求值为去重的节点对集合。
1270	
1271	    边集合只来自构造时给定的事实并集（OntologyModel.triples：显式 + 派生）；
1272	    序列取关系复合、选择取并集、逆向翻转节点对；p?/p* 的零次分支取
1273	    “全部三元组中实际出现过的主语或宾语”上的恒等节点对，不引入新术语；
1274	    p+/p* 按每个起点做带 visited 的深度优先搜索求传递闭包，访问过的节点
1275	    不重复展开，环状数据上必然有限结束。
1276	    各 AST 子树的结果按节点缓存，重复查询同一模型时求值过程完全一致。
1277	    """
1278	
1279	    __slots__ = ("_edges", "_nodes", "_cache")
1280	
1281	    def __init__(self, facts) -> None:
1282	        edges: dict = {}
1283	        nodes: set = set()
1284	        for fact in facts:
1285	            edges.setdefault(fact.predicate, set()).add(
1286	                (fact.subject, fact.object)
1287	            )
1288	            nodes.add(fact.subject)
1289	            nodes.add(fact.object)
1290	        self._edges = edges
1291	        self._nodes = frozenset(nodes)
1292	        self._cache: dict = {}
1293	
1294	    def identity(self) -> frozenset:
1295	        return frozenset((node, node) for node in self._nodes)
1296	
1297	    def eval(self, tree: tuple) -> frozenset:
1298	        cached = self._cache.get(tree)
1299	        if cached is not None:
1300	            return cached
1301	        tag = tree[0]
1302	        if tag == "edge":
1303	            pairs = frozenset(self._edges.get(tree[1], ()))
1304	        elif tag == "inv":
1305	            pairs = frozenset((v, u) for u, v in self.eval(tree[1]))
1306	        elif tag == "seq":
1307	            left = self.eval(tree[1])
1308	            right = self.eval(tree[2])
1309	            # 以中段节点连接：先走左路径再走右路径
1310	            right_by_mid: dict = {}
1311	            for mid, end in right:
1312	                right_by_mid.setdefault(mid, []).append(end)
1313	            composed = set()
1314	            for start, mid in left:
1315	                for end in right_by_mid.get(mid, ()):  # 中段不接续即无复合结果
1316	                    composed.add((start, end))
1317	            pairs = frozenset(composed)
1318	        elif tag == "alt":
1319	            pairs = self.eval(tree[1]) | self.eval(tree[2])
1320	        elif tag == "zeroone":
1321	            pairs = self.eval(tree[1]) | self.identity()
1322	        elif tag == "oneplus":
1323	            pairs = self._closure_positive(self.eval(tree[1]))
1324	        else:  # tag == "zero"
1325	            base = self.eval(tree[1])
1326	            pairs = self._closure_positive(base) | self.identity()
1327	        self._cache[tree] = pairs
1328	        return pairs

1330	    @staticmethod
1331	    def _closure_positive(base: frozenset) -> frozenset:
1332	        """一层或多层的传递闭包：从每个起点沿 base 边做带 visited 的 DFS，
1333	        环状数据上访问过的节点不会重复展开，必然有限结束。"""
1334	        adjacency: dict = {}
1335	        for start, end in base:
1336	            adjacency.setdefault(start, []).append(end)
1337	        reachable = set()
1338	        for source in adjacency:
1339	            seen = set()
1340	            stack = list(adjacency[source])
1341	            while stack:
1342	                node = stack.pop()
1343	                if node in seen:
1344	                    continue
1345	                seen.add(node)
1346	                reachable.add((source, node))
1347	                stack.extend(adjacency.get(node, ()))
1348	        return frozenset(reachable)

1351	def _match_patterns(matcher: _PathMatcher, bindings: List[dict], patterns) -> List[dict]:
1352	    """对一组三元组模式按序做内连接，返回所有扩展后的绑定。"""
1353	    for s, p, o in patterns:
1354	        pairs = matcher.eval(p.tree)
1355	        next_bindings: List[dict] = []
1356	        for binding in bindings:
1357	            for subj, obj in pairs:  # 节点对已去重，同一事实可被多个模式复用
1358	                if s[0] == _VAR:
1359	                    if s[1] in binding and subj != binding[s[1]]:
1360	                        continue
1361	                elif subj != s[1]:
1362	                    continue
1363	                extended = dict(binding)
1364	                if s[0] == _VAR:
1365	                    extended[s[1]] = subj
1366	                # 同一模式内主语/宾语可能是同一变量（如 ?x p ?x）
1367	                if o[0] == _VAR:
1368	                    if o[1] in extended and obj != extended[o[1]]:
1369	                        continue
1370	                elif obj != o[1]:
1371	                    continue
1372	                if o[0] == _VAR:
1373	                    extended[o[1]] = obj
1374	                next_bindings.append(extended)
1375	        bindings = next_bindings
1376	        if not bindings:

1378	    return bindings

1381	def _eval_filter(expr: tuple, binding: dict) -> bool:
1382	    kind = expr[0]
1383	    if kind == _EXPR_BOUND:
1384	        return expr[1] in binding
1385	    if kind == _EXPR_NOT_BOUND:
1386	        return expr[1] not in binding

1388	    def value_of(operand) -> Any:
1389	        tag, name, _pos = operand
1390	        if tag == _LIT:
1391	            return name
1392	        # 变量未绑定时等值/不等值比较均为假
1393	        return binding.get(name)
1394	
1395	    left = value_of(expr[1])
1396	    right = value_of(expr[2])
1397	    if left is None or right is None:
1398	        return False
1399	    equal = left == right
1400	    return equal if kind == _EXPR_EQ else not equal

1403	def run_query(model, text) -> QueryResult:
1404	    """在 model.triples 上执行查询，返回去重并按字典序排序后的 QueryResult。"""
1405	    properties = frozenset(getattr(model, "declared_properties", ()))
1406	    projection, clauses, star = _compile_query(text, properties)
1407	    if star:
1408	        projection = _star_variables(clauses)
1409	
1410	    facts = model.triples
1411	    matcher = _PathMatcher(facts)
1412	    bindings: List[dict] = [{}]
1413	    for kind, patterns, expr in clauses:
1414	        if kind == _CLAUSE_FILTER:
1415	            bindings = [b for b in bindings if _eval_filter(expr, b)]
1416	        elif kind == _CLAUSE_OPTIONAL:
1417	            joined: List[dict] = []
1418	            for binding in bindings:
1419	                matches = _match_patterns(matcher, [dict(binding)], patterns)
1420	                if matches:
1421	                    joined.extend(matches)
1422	                else:
1423	                    # 无匹配：保留原绑定一次，块内新变量保持未绑定
1424	                    joined.append(binding)
1425	            bindings = joined
1426	        elif kind == _CLAUSE_UNION:
1427	            # 每个分支从当前绑定独立求值，结果取并集：同名变量与既有绑定
1428	            # 冲突时该分支匹配自然落空，仅一分支绑定的变量随该分支保留。
1429	            unioned: List[dict] = []
1430	            for binding in bindings:
1431	                for branch in patterns:
1432	                    unioned.extend(_match_patterns(matcher, [dict(binding)], branch))
1433	            bindings = unioned
1434	        else:
1435	            bindings = _match_patterns(matcher, bindings, patterns)
1436	        if not bindings:
1437	            break

1439	    rows = {tuple(binding.get(name) for name in projection) for binding in bindings}
1440	    # None（未绑定）排在所有字符串之前，保证混合取值时字典序排序稳定。
1441	    ordered = tuple(
1442	        sorted(
1443	            rows,
1444	            key=lambda row: tuple((0, "") if value is None else (1, value) for value in row),
1445	        )
1446	    )
1447	    return QueryResult(projection, ordered)
